blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
The nav is sorted. The cards wrap. But there's one thing left.
The hero portrait. On a narrow screen it renders at its natural size and spills right out of its container. You haven't touched the image yet.
And it's not just this image. Any image you add later, a project screenshot, a logo, will do the same thing by default. Images have a fixed size unless you tell them otherwise.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
